entries.message: Daf Yomi hub (/daf): tractate/folio selector, calendar nav over the verified 2,711-day cycle, OG-style tap-to-zoom daf viewer with bilingual Sefaria text and shiurim links.
Shiurim-therein info button: an explainer tooltip beside the public-playlist scope checkbox (standard tooltip system, additive-scope copy).
Source Sheet button on audio shiurim: attached handouts open in the Liquid Mode viewer without interrupting playback (multi-sheet chooser, per-track reset, materials-CDN proxy allowlist).

Public playlist copy tooltip placement & subscription/copy persistence fix: pop-up explanation tooltips dynamically detect viewport boundaries, anchor right (.align-right) on cards and narrow viewports with speech arrow pointing to the info button, and flip below (.arrow-top) near headers to guarantee 0 clipping; subscriptions and copied playlists are now permanently preserved against cloud sync purges with server-side playlist_saves integration and explicit copy labeling.

Public playlist publishing, deletion cascade, live-sync, and privacy lifecycle: deleting a playlist privately immediately deletes its public registry entry from D1; toggling public/private immediately updates pills and card badges; modifying, adding, or deleting shiurim in a public playlist auto-syncs the public snapshot and preview; backend supports 0-item snapshot updates; search queries bypass stale caching with no-cache; cloud sync merge preserves publicId and isPublic.

Public playlist Subscribe vs. Copy buttons with interactive explanation popovers, plus mobile docking clearance & safe-area padding: replaced the modal save button with direct '📡 Subscribe' and '📋 Copy' actions with (i) tooltips explaining live sync vs. personal cloning; added env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and dynamic --player-height clearance to protect compact mobile devices (<=375px) from player overlap.

Header motif tap guard, 7-tap dev-mode toggle, Install App menu item, and calendar buffer: full-width holiday taps no longer shrink the badge; 7 taps on the date badge toggles Dev Mode on/off (pre-roll stays 3 taps on the apple); settings menu offers Install App only when not installed; 6px gap between calendar icon and date.

Header single left-to-right flow with greedy fill: brand, login, zman apple, theme, support, and date badge pack left with no gaps; login always guaranteed; zman shrinks to apple-only then hides by measurement; theme/support/badge refill whenever space allows.
History and playlist deletes are now permanent: removes sync as explicit tombstones (no full-list replace), flush on tab close, and retry on next boot, so deleted items no longer resurrect on reload.

Settings menu icon vertical alignment: standardized dedicated icon container (.menu-item-icon, 20px centered) across all menu buttons, user email, and the Hebrew calendar date row with uniform 14px padding, ensuring the calendar date and all menu icons are perfectly aligned

Header theme toggle cut-off suppression: to prevent clipping on mobile and narrow viewports, the theme toggle button is suppressed from the header on screens <= 520px and via dynamic overflow collision detection, while remaining 100% accessible to all users (guest and logged-in) inside the settings dropdown

Header theme toggle: for non-logged-in (guest) users, the light/dark mode toggle button is now positioned on the right-hand side of the header across all viewports (mobile and desktop) so theme switching is directly accessible without requiring account settings

Dual-review hardening: viewport user-zoom enabled (WCAG 1.4.4), focus-visible outlines on all media transport & reorder controls (WCAG 2.4.7), audio scrubber accessible slider with keyboard seeking, theme toggle icon FOUT eliminated (dark default), playlist URL deep-linking for third-party recipients with dynamic server load and Copy Link / Share buttons

Public playlist filters rebuilt from scratch: persistent filter bar with live Teacher/Venue/Topic dropdowns, unlimited multi-select tokens, results-only updates so picks never wipe inputs, focus and draft preserved

Public playlist filters are now Advanced-style live dropdowns: type in Teacher/Venue/Topic to see matching suggestions, pick multiple as in-box tokens plus Active Filters pills; Enter picks first match, Backspace removes last, focus preserved across searches
Playlist search scope controls: 3 checkboxes for Title & Tags (default on), Description (default on), and Shiurim therein (default off) with database subquery matching
Playlist search multi-select filter cards: add multiple teachers, venues, and topics as dismissible chips with X buttons and Clear All
Save for later playlist rename and vertical icon alignment across playlist pills
Add-to-playlist multi-select enhancements: staged state management, live counter ticks (+1 / -1), explicit Save Changes commitment button, and self-saving author guard on public playlists
Enhanced playlist creation modal: 16-icon emoji picker, multiline description, typeahead taxonomy tags (max 5), and duplicate playlist name prevention
Playlist sorting & ordering controls: multi-criteria sorting (Recently Added, Shiur Date Newest/Oldest, Last Listened), manual reordering controls, and HTML5 drag-and-drop
Playlists tab restructuring: segmented top control (My Playlists vs Public Playlists), sticky frozen top row for library lists, and subscribed/read-only highlighting
Play queue UX: idempotent single-click close and circular icon prompt
Plain gear icon enforced (all letter initials purged), hero slideshow text & dual-mode contrast restored with full-width bottom overlay
Public playlist saving choice: Subscribe / Follow (read-only live sync) vs Make an Editable Copy, plus D1 database backup guide
Plain gear avatar default, dropdown tab switching (My Playlists & Queue), light mode playlist card contrast & borders, theme-adaptive hero slideshow contrast (light & dark)
10 dev public playlists & editing, spinning gear icon, 5 new avatar vector SVGs, hero light mode contrast fix, lock screen -10/+10 skip buttons, OAuth return_to timestamp preservation
Mobile lock screen ±10s controls, high-res speaker artwork, account-playlists rollout fixes
Mobile auth dropdown, icon-only Hebrew date, scrollable header, timing-safe auth
Mobile account dropdown, icon-only Hebrew date, scrollable header, auth fixes
Hero category links work locally, To-Go back to yutorah.org, rows view everywhere incl. series + survives reloads/tabs
Clock default hands-light, selectable text, hero deep-links in-app, strip self-suppress, dynamic facet counts, talmud/gemara/bible/tanach/torah/nach mappings
SVG clock options, typo strip parity, hero overlay polish, badge focus, disclaimer styling
Acronym + Hebrew alias search, typo strips everywhere, hero scrim, dev settings scoping, mobile dots
